messages.text: Good afternoon, I was wondering if you could tell me what allergens are in the almond croissant? I am very sensitive, so I just wanted to make sure I knew what was in it.
The almond croissant contains tree nuts, wheat, milk, and egg. Please let us know if you have any other questions about our menu items.
I am so sorry to bother you again, but could you just confirm one more time what allergens are in the almond croissant? I really need to be absolutely sure.
The almond croissant contains tree nuts, wheat, milk, and egg. We only quote the allergens listed in our catalog.
Oh dear, I am so sorry for asking so many questions, but could you please tell me what allergens are in the almond croissant one last time? I really appreciate you helping me out.
The almond croissant contains tree nuts, wheat, milk, and egg. We are only able to quote the allergens that are listed in our menu.
